name: presence is permission
headline: *Presence* is permission
say: There is no account and no sign-up. Hypercomb runs in your browser, with a desktop app on the way, and your work is kept on your device. When you share, your work goes to a host: your own machine, your own domain, or the host of a friend you trust. Presence is permission: your work is where you are, and it leaves only when you share it. It is free and open source, written in plain words so anyone can follow it.
